    An annotation canvas widget

    Source: R/widget-canvas.R
    at_canvas.Rd

    An annotation canvas widget

    Usage

    at_canvas(
  img,
  project = NULL,
  tool = "pan",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL,
  options = list(),
  view = NULL,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    img

    An annot_image to display.

    project

    Optional annot_project whose ROIs are shown initially.

    tool

    Initial tool: one of "pan", "rect", "polygon", "freehand", "circle", "point", "edit", "erase", "probe" (emit a pixel position for spectra) or "select" (emit the clicked ROI id).

    width, height

    Widget dimensions.

    elementId

    Optional element id.

    options

    A list of extra options passed to the widget.

    view

    Optional band view passed to at_tile_source().

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    An htmlwidget object.

    See also

    at_canvas_proxy(), at_tile_source()

    Other shiny: atCanvasOutput(), at_annotate(), at_app(), at_canvas_fit(), at_canvas_proxy(), at_canvas_set_annotations(), at_canvas_set_band(), at_canvas_set_overlay(), at_canvas_set_selection(), at_canvas_set_tool(), at_tile_source(), renderAtCanvas()

    Examples

    at_canvas(at_example_image("tissue"))
